purpose: Label-free observation packet preprocessing for five receipt-bound complete-dialogue Audio2Tool recordings. Thirty-five original packets are reused after full hash verification. Only five derived WAVs contact the CPU-only feature-cache sidecar, each once, with a one-token completion whose meaning is never read. The pass emits one deterministic 40-row promotion receipt and one binding map. Gold, transcripts, task text, outputs, scores, future turns, retries, overwrite behavior, and the GPU decoder are outside this path.
